title: Wet Fart
blurb: Every soundboard eventually reaches the high-risk branch of the taxonomy, and here it is. The classic fart is innocent slapstick; this one carries clear implications, and every listener works them out inside about a tenth of a second. The small hesitation while they do it is funnier than the noise. That explains why the wet variant is the connoisseur's pick for prank videos and fail-compilation punctuation, because it does not interrupt a moment so much as add a plot to it. Reach for it when a regular fart is simply not disrespectful enough for whatever is happening on screen.
origin: The fart taxonomy's most dangerous branch.
